newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy gives Animex buy rating.
newsitem.headline: Handlowy gives Animex buy rating.

text.p: Investors should buy shares of Polish food trader and producer Animex SA, in part due to the firm's strong market position and trade growth with former Soviet states, the brokerage unit of Bank Handlowy SA said.

"On the basis of the researched fundamental factors, we recommend to investors with medium (2-3 months) and long-term investment horizons, to purchase shares of Animex," Handlowy said in a report dated September 27 but released on Monday.
On September 27 Animex closed at 9.1 zlotys and slipped to 8.7 zlotys at Monday's close.
Handlowy said investors should buy Animex shares anywhere below 11.5 zlotys.

It said Animex's strong domestic position was made possible in part by the vertical integration of the Animex capital group, and that Animex would invest over 1996-1998 to upgrade red-meat production and restructure poultry enterprises.

Handlowy said nearly half of Animex's net sales revenue last year came from exports, though export growth in pork and poultry foods to the European Union and the United States was growing more slowly than desirable.
It predicted Animex would make a net profit of 13.5 million zlotys in 1996 and 17.5 million next year on sales of 470 million and 535 million zlotys respectively.
Last year Animex netted 41.5 million zlotys on 531 million zlotys in sales after receiving large tax refunds.
